title.en: The fidelity count: the classical statements against the English chapter
title.zh: 忠实之测：中华本之经对英文本之句

statement.en: Over 270 條, the 中华本's 經 introduce fewer referents the Lean statement lacks than the canonical chapter's English clauses (0.09 against 0.81 per pair, CI [-0.92, -0.54]) and fewer agents, and leave out fewer binders; LLM-coded, provisional.
statement.zh: 在 270 條上，中华本之经引入 Lean 陈述所没有之所指少于英文本之句（每对 0.09 对 0.81），施动者亦少，所漏变元亦少；大模型编码，暂定。

hypotheses.en: Codebook v1.1 (FIDELITY.md §3 with two logged clarifications from calibration); the Lean statements of receipt 20261022T110022.458880Z with one level of unfolding; the alignment of 經 clauses to declarations by two coders and an adjudicator; one coder (Claude) on both sides of the main set.
hypotheses.zh: 编码本 v1.1（FIDELITY.md §3，加校准中记录之两条澄清）；回执 20261022T110022.458880Z 之 Lean 陈述，展开一层；经之子句与声明之对齐由二编码者与一裁定者定；主集两边皆由一编码者（Claude）编。

does_not_show.en: That classical Chinese is the best expression of the core: one English text is compared, in another register.
does_not_show.zh: 古汉语是核心最好之表达：只比较了一个英文本，且体裁不同。

does_not_show.en: That the result survives a human audit or a second coder on the main-set 經: neither was run, and the coder of the main-set 經 wrote them.
does_not_show.zh: 结果经得起人工复核或主集之经之第二编码者：二者皆未运行，且主集之经之编码者即其作者。

does_not_show.en: Anything about readers (H2): the reading test is not run.
does_not_show.zh: 任何关于读者之事（H2）：阅读试验未运行。

does_not_show.en: That the gain belongs to classical Chinese rather than to the name table's discipline (each name states what it does not carry and is anchored on a declaration): no controlled English edition under the same discipline was measured.
does_not_show.zh: 所得属于古汉语而非名表之纪律（每名写明所不带之义并锚于声明）：未测同样纪律下之受控英文本。

validation_scope.en: Alignment by two coders (κ 0.952); coding of 672 pairs by Claude, and of the calibration set and 320 English segments by GPT (blind, separate languages); α on X 0.69 English, 0.53 Chinese (calibration); cluster bootstrap over 條, Wilcoxon, McNemar, cluster-robust Poisson; plan and amendments fixed before any main result was read.
validation_scope.zh: 对齐由二编码者为之（κ 0.952）；672 对由 Claude 编码，校准集与 320 段英文由 GPT 编码（盲，分语言）；X 之 α 英文 0.69，中文 0.53（校准）；按條之聚类自助法、Wilcoxon、McNemar、聚类稳健之 Poisson；计划与修订皆定于读主结果之前。

next_delta.en: A controlled English edition under the same discipline, measured the same way; the second coder on the main-set 經 and a human audit; F3, F4 and the reading test; and a test of the calibration observation that the authoring model finds less in its own text than another family does.
next_delta.zh: 同样纪律下之受控英文本，以同样程序测之；主集之经之第二编码者与人工复核；F3、F4 与阅读试验；并检验校准中之观察：作者模型于己文所检出少于他家模型。

correspondence.en: Board item FC1, on Ren's request to run the fidelity count; the scope was cut by his direction during the run (provenance, not warrant). Reading (the AI's, D63): the classical statements are the more exact reading code of the two compared, not the best expression.
correspondence.zh: 看板项 FC1，按 Ren 运行忠实之测之要求；范围在运行中按其指示收缩（来历，不是根据）。读法（AI 的，D63）：所比二者中，古典之经是较精确之读码，不是最好之表达。

detail.en: Tests the WL chapter's claim that the classical code is a fitting reading layer.
detail.zh: 检验 WL 一章「古典之码是贴切之读法层」之说。

progress.en: The fidelity count run on the reduced scope.
progress.zh: 忠实之测在收缩之范围上运行。

history.en: 23 October 2026: the confound of language with the name table's discipline and its control (a controlled English edition) added to the scope and next step; the authoring coder's blind spot recorded as an open observation in the results.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：语言与名表纪律之混淆及其对照（受控英文本）补入范围与下一步；作者编码者之盲点作为开放观察记于结果。
